text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: elevated 5xx rate for inference-gateway detected in us-west1 and eu-west1. Error rate > 6% sustained for 5m. Paging oncall.

sara_oncall: I'm on it, joining bridge now. Can someone post initial impact? :phone:

mike_infra: seeing repeated segfaults from model-runner pods on us-west1 nodes. pattern: OOM then SIGSEGV in libattention_quant.so.

jana_ml: which model variant? we've been running quant-a2-8b on those hosts.

mike_infra: quant-a2-8b on g4dn pools. quick excerpt from node logs:
```
[2026-03-17T21:07:12Z] runner[pid=1421]: killed by SIGSEGV (code=0) at 0x7f4a2e2b
Backtrace:
  model_runner(+0x12ab4) [0x55f2a12ab4]
  libattention_quant.so(+0x1f4c) [0x7f4a2e2b1f4c]
```

lucas_sre: traffic view: gateway retries spiking, client latencies rising, overall 5xx -> some customers time out. cs_rep can you list affected tenants?

cs_rep: flagged acme-inc, globex-ml, and novafarm. outreach in progress; we've opened Priority channel for acme.

sara_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) rollback to non-quant variant (a2-8b-fp16) on affected pools, 2) route latency-critical traffic to hosted fallback (redwood-small), 3) cordon + drain suspect nodes. I'll coordinate rollouts.

opsbot: Triggering rollout: deployment/model-runner: quant-a2-8b -> a2-8b-fp16. Progress: 0/46 pods updated.

mike_infra: cordoning suspect nodes and draining pods now. command I ran:
```
kubectl cordon node-usw1-5 && kubectl drain node-usw1-5 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=30
```
opsbot: 12 pods restarted across us-west1.

jana_ml: note: quant kernel v2.1.3 has a known memory regression when sequence > 1024 under multithreaded paths. If OOMs persist, set REDWOOD_KERN_QUANT=0 to disable quant fastpath.

sara_oncall: mike, can you apply env patch to a couple of runner pods as stopgap? we'll roll config after.

mike_infra: patch applied to runner-deploy-33 and runner-deploy-34, restarting. opsbot shows 2/46 updated.

elaine_pm: CS update sent: customers notified of degraded performance and our mitigations. ETA ~20m.

lucas_sre: lowered gateway max_concurrent temporarily to reduce pressure and give KV cache time to warm. This should reduce cold-kv OOM spikes.

incident-bot: Attach artifacts to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incident-arch/4381234567/. Uploading core dumps and logs.

mike_infra: cores uploaded: s3://redwood-incident-arch/4381234567/core.globex.20260317.gz and runner-logs.tar.gz

sara_oncall: error rate trending down to ~1.5% after rollbacks and routing. Fallback handled ~18% of requests in the peak window. Still seeing isolated segfaults but no customer-facing outages.

cs_rep: acme acknowledged workaround; asked for RC timeline.

lucas_sre: taking over bridge for extended mitigation and RCA. next steps: reproduce with quant lib v2.1.3, capture heap profiles and perf traces, and prepare rollback of quant lib release if confirmed.

jana_ml: I can repro locally with stress test: `python tools/stress_infer.py --model a2-8b --quant --seq 2048 --threads 8` — mem growth observed then segfault. attaching local repro steps to artifacts.

sara_oncall: declaring incident mitigated. I'll keep pager open for 30m for watch. Thanks everyone.

opsbot: Pager note: incident severity downgraded P1 -> P2. Assigned to lucas_sre for follow-up.

lucas_sre: acknowledged, creating RCA draft and linking artifacts.

incident-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED at 4381234780. Reminder: file postmortem within 3 business days and tag with `incident/oom-quant-kernel`. :white_check_mark:
